components.name: Chart/Radial bar
components.description: Compact progress comparison: one ring per category, all on the same 0–100% scale, track in dataviz/track. Default: up to 4 rings with a legend and values; Progress: 2–3 goal rings with the overall value in the centre. Rings are read by length, so keep the order stable (largest outside). React: <RadialBarChart data variant="default|progress" />
